text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 1011 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Barangays Looy, Bongo, Biarong, Lamud, Kigan, Pandan, Romoangaob, Basak (Upi side), Pilar,
San Jose and Itaw, all in the Municipality of Upi, Province of Maguindanao, are hereby detached and
separated therefrom to form and constitute a distinct and independent municipality which is created to be
known as the Municipality of South Upi without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother
municipality of Upi. The seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Sitio Timanan in
Barangay Romoangaob."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
